name: How long does mold remediation under flooring take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mold remediation under flooring take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of mold remediation under flooring depends on the scope of the contamination. A small, isolated mold issue might be resolved within 1-3 days, including removal and initial drying. More extensive infestations, particularly those requiring significant demolition, structural drying, and reconstruction, can take a week or longer. The drying phase is crucial and can vary based on humidity levels and the amount of moisture present. A professional assessment can provide a more accurate timeline based on your specific situation. Our goal is efficient and thorough restoration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold remediation time varies from 1-3 days for small areas to over a week for extensive infestations, depending on scope and drying needs.
